ben: Heads-up: PartnerNimbus delivered a nightly usage archive but we're seeing clock skew across edge gateways. Some events have future timestamps (up to +15m) and others are delayed by hours. Need a policy for timestamp normalization before reconciliation.
anya: can you paste a small sample?
ben: sample rows (sanitized):
NIM-01,gw-17,2026-03-23T11:02:12+00:00,300,credits,evt-9001
NIM-01,gw-17,2026-03-23T11:17:45+00:00,120,credits,evt-9002
NIM-01,gw-17,2026-03-23T10:47:00+00:00,60,credits,evt-8999
yusuf: looks like gateway clocks drift +/-15m and sometimes batch replays arrive 3-4h late. For dedupe we need to rely on external_event_id (evt-*) and partner batch_id. If missing, use ingest_timestamp as tie-breaker.
megan: billing impact: late arrivals change hourly totals. propose: normalize event_ts to partner_provided_ts if within 30m of ingest time; otherwise tag as "late" and attribute to ingest_hour. Hold such items in draft invoice and surface in partner reconciliation.
anya: ingestion rule suggestion:
- prefer external_event_id + partner_id for dedupe
- if external_event_id missing: key = partner_id + device_id + event_ts_rounded_to_minute
- if event_ts differs from ingest_ts by >30m: mark as LATE and attribute to ingest_hour; allow backfill window of 7 days to reassign after reconciliation with partner manifest
- require partner to include batch manifest with totals and per-event checksums for any backfill >24h
billing-bot: alert: partnernimbus-ingest job 2026-03-23T12:05Z -> 482 late events flagged. ticket #4021 created.
yusuf: also recommend storing both event_ts and ingest_ts and preserving original units. Convert units at ingest using partner rate table and keep raw unit values for audit.
megan: draft billing policy: for "LATE" tagged items we will hold settlement for 72h and run a delta compare vs partner manifest; if partner-provided manifest reconciles, reassign to partner_ts and adjust invoice; if not reconciled within 7d, invoice remains attributed to ingest_hour and we open a discrepancy ticket.
anya: action items:
- ben: request PartnerNimbus add batch_id and external_event_id on next export (ETA 24h)
- yusuf: implement LATE tag + store both timestamps + 30m normalization rule (EOD)
- megan: produce billing hold + late-arrival reconciliation playbook (tomorrow)
- infra/billing-bot: monitor ticket #4021 and escalate if >100 late events/hr
ben: thanks all 44b I'll update once PartnerNimbus confirms the batching fields."
